title: pacod-gw / Gateway internals
description: The gateway's own behaviour: the delay it adds, back-pressure, the event and audit spools, configuration rollout, and plugins.

panels.title: Delay in proxy mode, median
panels.description: Median of the time the gateway adds to a proxied call. Target: 0.5 ms.

panels.title: Delay in proxy mode, 99th percentile
panels.description: Target: 2 ms. The alert fires when this stays above the target for 10 minutes.

panels.title: Delay in managed mode, 99th percentile
panels.description: Target: 5 ms in the same dialect, 8 ms with translation. The alert fires above 8 ms.

panels.title: Streams in flight
panels.description: Calls being answered right now on the selected instances.

panels.title: Events dropped in the selected range
panels.description: Usage events lost because the spool was full. Anything above zero means incomplete reports.

panels.title: Audit records dropped in the selected range
panels.description: Audit-mode records lost because the audit spool was full.

panels.title: Delay in proxy mode by stage, 99th percentile
panels.description: Time added by the gateway: "total" is the gateway delay, "pre" the part before the provider call and "post" the part after it. The dashed line is the 2 ms target for the total.

panels.title: Delay in managed mode by stage, 99th percentile
panels.description: Time added by the gateway per stage. The dashed line is the 8 ms target for calls with translation.

panels.title: Delay by provider, 99th percentile
panels.description: The gateway delay per provider. A provider that stands out points at its adapter or its translation.

panels.title: Delay by mode, median
panels.description: The typical gateway delay per mode. Targets: 0.5 ms in proxy mode, 1 ms in managed mode.

panels.title: Streams in flight by instance
panels.description: Calls being answered. Above the per-instance cap the gateway answers 503 gateway_overloaded.

panels.title: Rejections by reason
panels.description: Requests the gateway refused, per second. The alert fires when one reason stays above one per second for 10 minutes.

panels.title: Event spool size
panels.description: Usage events waiting to be shipped to the analytics service. It should stay near zero; growth means the analytics service or ClickHouse is not taking them.

panels.title: Audit spool size
panels.description: Audit-mode records waiting to be shipped. The dashed line is 90 % of the default cap of 4 GiB.

panels.title: Events dropped per minute
panels.description: Usage events lost because the spool was full.

panels.title: Audit records dropped per minute
panels.description: Audit-mode records lost because the audit spool was full.

panels.title: Configuration version by instance
panels.description: The configuration version each instance has applied. All lines should lie on top of each other.

panels.title: Configuration versions behind
panels.description: How many configuration versions an instance has not applied yet. It should be zero except for a moment after a change; the alert fires when it stays above zero for 30 seconds.

panels.title: Plugin time before the call, 95th percentile
panels.description: How long plugins take on a call before it is planned, per plugin and engine (docs/plugin-concept.md). Shadow bindings run alongside the provider call and do not delay it; this is kept apart from the gateway delay.

panels.title: Plugin verdicts per minute
panels.description: What plugins did with calls: allow, block, flag, and would_block or would_flag for shadow bindings and rules in trial.

panels.title: Plugin errors per minute
panels.description: Calls a plugin gave no verdict on, by why: timeout, upstream, limited, invalid_answer, no_credential, not_built. An enforcing binding with on_error closed refuses those calls; the alert fires above 5 % for 10 minutes.

panels.title: Plugin answers from the cache
panels.description: The share of the intent plugin's answers that came from its cache instead of an engine, per instance's cache.

panels.title: Response cache: what it did, per minute
panels.description: Calls answered from a kept answer (hit), looked for and not found (miss), found by a binding in shadow mode (would_hit), refreshed or bypassed at the caller's request or because they were not deterministic; and answers kept (stored) or not worth keeping (not_kept).

panels.title: Response cache hits
panels.description: The share of the calls the cache looked up that it answered: hits over hits, misses and would-be hits.

panels.title: Response cache lookups, 95th percentile
panels.description: How long a call waits for the cache's store before it is answered from it or goes on to its provider. Bounded by the binding's timeout (100 ms by default).

panels.title: Response cache store errors per minute
panels.description: The store failed to read (get) or to keep (put) an answer, or was skipped while it was failing (skipped). Calls are then served by their providers, without the cache.
